channel.title: The Daily Digest
channel.description: One top story from each of my chosen publications, updated daily.

item.title: NYT: Trump Is Said to Have Directed Effort to Reinstate Nvidia Chief
item.description: President Trump decided he wanted to do whatever he could to help Jensen Huang get his old job back, two people familiar with the matter said.

item.title: NPR: Mending relationships over the holidays? Considering a truce? NPR wants to know
item.description: Has a political or social issue broken down a relationship that was important to you? Can it be repaired? Tell us what's going on. You might be asked to participate in a possible upcoming segment on All Things Considered…

item.title: BBC News: My approach to EU is pragmatic, says Burnham
item.description: The prime minister also said his predecessors who have urged him not to reopen the Brexit debate are "stuck in the past".

item.title: The Guardian: How freaked out should we be? After mass outages, experts tell us how close we are to ‘doomsday’
item.description: As tech, travel and banking failures sweep the US, analysts and cyber-security directors discuss AI, underfunding and what keeps them up at night Grounded flights. Bank websites crashing. Microsoft Outlook outages grindi…

item.title: Al Jazeera: US escalates sanctions on Iran, targets ‘shadow banking’ networks
item.description: US Treasury sanctions over two dozen Iranian entities, citing efforts to disrupt Tehran's global financial activities.

item.title: Ars Technica: Trump halts Iowa detonation, says new governor to blame if it blows accidentally
item.description: The Army said on Sunday that it would carry out the detonation on Wednesday.

item.title: WIRED Backchannel: The Manosphere Isn’t Ready for Brothercore
item.description: Vulnerable, huggable, affirming, chiseled: Welcome to Hey Brother House, a content incubator for bros who just want to trauma-dump and play Mario Kart.

item.title: WIRED Science: The Feds Left Iowans in the Dark About Plans to Blow Up Tons of Lead
item.description: The US Army plans to blow up 9,500 pounds of lead azide held at an Iowa ammunition plant. Local officials say they learned most of the details through a press release.

item.title: WIRED Business: How to Win Big Betting on Jensen Huang? Listen to Trump
item.description: Prediction market traders profited from the Nvidia CEO’s comeback by following the White House’s lead. “It’s 2026 and Trump is president, scandal schmandal,” says one winner.

item.title: The New Yorker: Is Norway’s Oil Fund a Blessing or a Curse?
item.description: In a culture used to thrifty living, a two-trillion-dollar bonanza makes people very uneasy.

item.title: New York Mag Curbed: Hugh Jackman Finally Sells His Perry Street Triplex
item.description: The actor’s West Village apartment, which he still owned with his ex-wife, was designed by Richard Meier, inside and out.
